title: Choice of one affine residue representative
statement:
For one derived arrow between strictly perfect affine models, affine residue naturality and the perfect affine representative theorem yield a target residue comparison and one chain map whose residue homology map agrees with the derived-fibre functor map.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem picard_residue_homology_choose_model_map [∀ Y : Scheme.{v}, HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))] (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hwU : w ∈ U) (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom) (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory W) (b : E ⟶ E') (K C : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K) (hC : IsStrictlyPerfect W U C) (m : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) (m' : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E' ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) (eK : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w) (hNat : ∃ eC : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p C ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E' 1 w, ∀ (φ : K ⟶ C), DerivedCategory.Q.map φ = m.inv ≫ (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map b ≫ m'.hom → ∀ z, eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) = (derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w 1).map b (eK z)) : ∃ eC : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p C ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E' 1 w, ∃ φ : K ⟶ C, ∀ z, eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) = (derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w 1).map b (eK z)
